q: Spec-driven development (SDD) inverts the traditional workflow by treating specifications as the source of truth and code as a generated or verified secondary artifact.
r: Include: practitioner guide to SDD with AI coding assistants and Spec Kit; group (a), full paper.

q: We evaluate 128 runs covering 32 features across five repositories.
r: Include: multi-agent SDD pipeline on Spec Kit with controlled comparison of four configurations over 128 runs; group (a).

q: This report formalises Spec-Driven Agentic Development (SDAD) as a synthesis of disciplined up-front formalisation and high-velocity implementation
r: Include: conceptual SDD framework for coding agents with metrics and governance; group (a), full-length report.

q: AI coding agents dramatically accelerate implementation speed but introduce two structural failure modes
r: Include: spec-anchored framework for coding agents with a drift gate and a worked example; group (a).

r: Include: empirical test of SDD specification portability across coding agents (Kiro, Gemini, Copilot); group (a).

q: We study SDD in practice through a thematic analysis of Reddit discussions, interviews with 21 practitioners
r: Include: empirical study of SDD as practised with coding agents (interviews, repository mining); group (a).
